Amazon is building edge-first fleet management for Physical AI through AWS IoT. The Software Development Engineer I will develop edge-runtime components and cloud services to deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across autonomous machines, including in disconnected environments.

Responsibilities
Implement well-scoped edge-runtime components in C++ and Rust against existing designs including local artifact caching peer discovery and coordinated OTA updates across nested processor hierarchies
Build cloud-side services that orchestrate and monitor fleets of edge devices operating in disconnected environments
Debug device and software issues alongside senior engineers identify root causes and contribute fixes that improve system reliability for autonomous machines operating offline
Contribute to security systems that protect AI models from tampering on physically accessible hardware through cryptographic verification and signed-artifact workflows
Participate in the full software development lifecycle with your team - scoping, code reviews, testing, deployment, and operational support - while using generative AI tools where appropriate to augment your productivity
